A place-marketing concept

Davis is built for what’s next. Let’s make that story visible.

Your new economic development plan names the opportunity clearly: position Davis as a premier destination for innovation, entrepreneurship, and high-quality living. Hallpass Digital can help turn that ambition into a story people see, remember, and act on.

A focused two-minute read for Katie Yancey

A Hallpass point of view

Made to be watched, not just approved.

We’ve all seen the drone footage with the inspirational voiceover. It has its place. But attention rarely starts at 400 feet.

We start with people: the founder building in Davis, the shop that’s anchored downtown for decades, the UC Davis researcher whose work could change the world.

Story. Hooks. Emotion. Human interest. That’s what people choose to watch—and the results below are the proof.

01Your plan says

The strategic direction is already set. The next step is a publishing system that gives that direction a recognizable voice, a steady cadence, and measurable reach.

“Develop a unified branding and marketing initiative that positions Davis as a premier destination for innovation, entrepreneurship, and high-quality living.”

City of Davis Economic Development Strategic Plan, approved March 3, 2026

The implementation window is open. The council staff report notes that marketing-related initiatives “are anticipated to require assistance from outside parties” to maximize near-term return.

Illustrative 12-month view
01 · One-time

Launch work

  • Baseline visibility review and stakeholder input
  • “Elevate Davis” messaging system: brand narrative, voice, and key messages
  • KPI baseline tied to the plan: 25,000+ impressions per year, 20+ attraction inquiries by 2031, and brand launch by mid-2027
  • Shop Local campaign framework setup
  • Quarterly newsletter setup
02 · Monthly

Recurring engine

  • Always-on social and video: available property and site highlights; growth and investment updates; doing-business Q&As covering permitting, incentives, and RFI readiness
  • Community storytelling: jobs and workforce; education and talent at UC Davis; arts, cycling, and quality of life
  • Paid digital campaign management: Hallpass plans, launches, and manages campaigns targeting site selectors, talent, and visitors, in service of the plan’s targets of 25,000+ impressions per year and 20+ attraction inquiries by 2031. Strategy, campaign setup, creative, management, and optimization are included; advertising spend is paid separately by the City—billed directly by the ad platforms or passed through at cost—and is not included in the retainer.
  • Year-round Shop Local campaign delivery with the Chamber and DDBA
  • Graduation-season promotion
  • Weekly visitor and business events round-up email, in the spirit of What’s Happening Around Ardmore
  • Publishing the quarterly newsletter called for in the plan
03 · Quarterly

Report + plan

  • Board-ready performance report
  • Planning session for the next quarter
